entities.name: Fedex Express Flight 910
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On October 28, 2016, FedEx Express Flight 910, a McDonnell Douglas MD-10-10F flying from Memphis International Airport to Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International Airport was involved in a runway skid after a landing gear collapse, which resulted in a fire partially destroying the left engine and wing. No one was killed, however, the captain suffered minor injuries.
